name: eesoc-website
description: Root of the eesoc-website repo: holds the Playwright install the e2e suites (tests/e2e/) run with. The specs live outside frontend/, and Node resolves packages by walking up from the spec file, so the install has to sit at the repo root for tests/e2e/<slug>/*.spec.js to find @playwright/test. The frontend keeps its own package.json for the build toolchain (vite); nothing here is part of any built image.
